```{r}

## Posterior predictive checks for model ascertainment weights
## Backend: R / ggplot2

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(rstan)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(patchwork)
  library(svglite)
  library(ragg)
  library(readxl)
})

# ============================================================
# 1. Parameters
# ============================================================

# ---------- paths ----------
stan_dir <- "."

data_dir   <- file.path(stan_dir, "01_data")
result_dir <- file.path(stan_dir, "02_results")
fig_dir    <- file.path(result_dir, "ppc_figures")

data_file <- file.path(data_dir, "ascertain_all_trialdata_260206.xlsx")
data_sheet <- "Sheet1"

output_file <- file.path(
  result_dir,
  "model_ascertain_EXP3_2_output_260410.Rdata"
)

dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---------- data ----------
subject_prefix <- "^73"
n_subjects <- 43

# ---------- PPC ----------
set.seed(20260617)

n_draw_max <- 100
# Grand PPC
grand_xlim <- c(-60, 60)

# Individual PPC
ind_xlim <- c(-15, 22)
ind_ylim <- c(-15, 22)

# Trial PPC
trial_xlim <- c(-52, 60)
trial_ylim <- c(-52, 60)

# ---------- output size: inch ----------
single_fig_width  <- 3.4
single_fig_height <- 3.0

three_panel_width  <- 10.5
three_panel_height <- 3.4

fig_dpi <- 600

# ---------- colors ----------
pal <- list(
  true   = "#1B4E6B",
  pred   = "#B9C1C7",
  point  = "#2D6F8E",
  accent = "#B64B3A",
  text   = "#1A1A1A",
  subtext = "#4D4D4D"
)

# ---------- font ----------
base_family <- "Arial"

# ---------- theme sizes ----------
base_size <- 8

axis_title_size <- 16
axis_text_size  <- 16

plot_title_size    <- 16
#plot_subtitle_size <- 8
plot_tag_size      <- 16

panel_note_size <- 4.0

# ---------- geoms ----------
axis_linewidth <- 0.45
tick_linewidth <- 0.45
tick_length_mm <- 1.8

density_pred_linewidth <- 0.22
density_true_linewidth <- 0.75
density_pred_alpha <- 0.28

abline_linewidth <- 0.55

point_stroke <- 0.25
point_alpha_ind <- 0.86
point_alpha_trial <- 0.18
point_size_trial <- 0.7
point_size_ind_max <- 3.8

# ---------- margins ----------
plot_margin_top <- 4
plot_margin_right <- 4
plot_margin_bottom <- 4
plot_margin_left <- 4

axis_title_x_margin <- 3
axis_title_y_margin <- 3
axis_text_x_margin <- 3
axis_text_y_margin <- 3


# ============================================================
# 2. Helper functions
# ============================================================

theme_ppc <- function(base_size = 8, base_family = "Arial") {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(colour = pal$text),

      axis.line = element_line(
        linewidth = axis_linewidth,
        colour = "black"
      ),

      axis.ticks = element_line(
        linewidth = tick_linewidth,
        colour = "black"
      ),

      axis.ticks.length = unit(tick_length_mm, "mm"),

      axis.title = element_text(
        size = axis_title_size
      ),

      axis.title.x = element_text(
        margin = margin(t = axis_title_x_margin)
      ),

      axis.title.y = element_text(
        margin = margin(r = axis_title_y_margin)
      ),

      axis.text = element_text(
        size = axis_text_size,
        colour = pal$text
      ),

      axis.text.x = element_text(
        margin = margin(t = axis_text_x_margin)
      ),

      axis.text.y = element_text(
        margin = margin(r = axis_text_y_margin)
      ),

      plot.title = element_text(
        size = plot_title_size,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0
      ),
# 
#       plot.subtitle = element_text(
#         size = plot_subtitle_size,
#         colour = pal$subtext,
#         hjust = 0
#       ),

      plot.tag = element_text(
        size = plot_tag_size,
        face = "bold",
        family = base_family
      ),

      plot.margin = margin(
        t = plot_margin_top,
        r = plot_margin_right,
        b = plot_margin_bottom,
        l = plot_margin_left
      ),

      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )
}

fmt_p <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("P = NA")
  if (p < 0.001) return("P < 0.001")
  paste0("P = ", formatC(p, digits = 3, format = "f"))
}

spearman_label <- function(x, y, prefix = "Spearman") {
  keep <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)

  test <- suppressWarnings(
    cor.test(
      x[keep],
      y[keep],
      method = "spearman",
      exact = FALSE
    )
  )

  sprintf(
    "%s rho = %.2f\n%s",
    prefix,
    unname(test$estimate),
    fmt_p(test$p.value)
  )
}

panel_note <- function(label, x = 5, y = 95) {
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = x,
    y = y,
    label = label,
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 1,
    size = panel_note_size,
    family = base_family,
    colour = pal$text,
    lineheight = 0.95
  )
}

save_pub <- function(plot, stem, width, height, dpi = fig_dpi) {
  file_base <- file.path(fig_dir, stem)

  svglite::svglite(
    paste0(file_base, ".svg"),
    width = width,
    height = height
  )
  print(plot)
  dev.off()

  grDevices::cairo_pdf(
    paste0(file_base, ".pdf"),
    width = width,
    height = height,
    family = base_family
  )
  print(plot)
  dev.off()

  ragg::agg_tiff(
    paste0(file_base, ".tiff"),
    width = width,
    height = height,
    units = "in",
    res = dpi,
    compression = "lzw"
  )
  print(plot)
  dev.off()
}


# ============================================================
# 3. Load data and model
# ============================================================

if (!file.exists(data_file)) {
  stop("Cannot find data file: ", data_file)
}

if (!file.exists(output_file)) {
  stop("Cannot find model output file: ", output_file)
}

data_df <- read_excel(
  data_file,
  sheet = data_sheet
) %>%
  filter(grepl(subject_prefix, as.character(SubID))) %>%
  mutate(
    SubID_stan = as.integer(as.factor(SubID)),
    PE_scaled = as.numeric(scale(PE))
  )

stan_data <- list(
  N = nrow(data_df),
  S = n_subjects,
  subject = data_df$SubID_stan,
  x = data_df$PE_scaled,
  y = data_df$alloc_var
)

load(output_file)

if (!exists("model_output")) {
  stop("The loaded RData file does not contain `model_output`.")
}


# ============================================================
# 4. Extract posterior predictive samples
# ============================================================

y_true <- stan_data$y

y_rep <- rstan::extract(
  model_output,
  pars = "y_rep"
)$y_rep

if (ncol(y_rep) != length(y_true)) {
  stop(
    "Length mismatch: ncol(y_rep) = ",
    ncol(y_rep),
    ", length(y_true) = ",
    length(y_true)
  )
}

y_pred_mean <- colMeans(y_rep, na.rm = TRUE)

dat_ppc <- tibble(
  subject = stan_data$subject,
  y_true = y_true,
  y_pred = y_pred_mean
)

subject_ppc <- dat_ppc %>%
  group_by(subject) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_true = mean(y_true, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_pred = mean(y_pred, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_trial = sum(is.finite(y_true) & is.finite(y_pred)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

n_draw <- min(n_draw_max, nrow(y_rep))
draw_id <- sample(seq_len(nrow(y_rep)), n_draw)

grand_ppc <- as_tibble(
  t(y_rep[draw_id, , drop = FALSE]),
  .name_repair = "minimal"
) %>%
  set_names(paste0("draw_", seq_len(n_draw))) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "draw",
    values_to = "y_pred"
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(y_pred))

true_dist <- tibble(y_true = y_true) %>%
  filter(is.finite(y_true))


# ============================================================
# 5. Grand-average PPC
# ============================================================

p_grand <- ggplot() +
  geom_density(
    data = grand_ppc,
    aes(x = y_pred, group = draw, color = "Predicted"),
    linewidth = density_pred_linewidth,
    # colour = pal$pred,
    alpha = density_pred_alpha,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_density(
    data = true_dist,
    aes(x = y_true, color="Observed"),
    linewidth = density_true_linewidth,
    # colour = pal$true,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      Observed = pal$true,
      Predicted = pal$pred
    )
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = grand_xlim,
    clip = "on"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Grand-average PPC",
    # subtitle = paste0(n_draw, " posterior predictive draws"),
    x = "Allocation",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  # annotate(
  #   "text",
  #   x = 5,
  #   y = 0.058,
  #   label = "Observed: blue\nPredicted: grey",
  #   hjust = 0,
  #   vjust = 1,
  #   size = panel_note_size,
  #   family = base_family,
  #   colour = pal$text,
  #   lineheight = 0.95
  # ) +
  theme_ppc()


# ============================================================
# 6. Individual-wise PPC
# ============================================================

label_ind <- spearman_label(
  subject_ppc$mean_true,
  subject_ppc$mean_pred
)

p_ind <- ggplot(
  subject_ppc,
  aes(x = mean_true, y = mean_pred)
) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = "22",
    linewidth = abline_linewidth,
    colour = pal$accent
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(size = n_trial),
    shape = 21,
    fill = pal$point,
    colour = "black",
    stroke = point_stroke,
    alpha = point_alpha_ind
  ) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = point_size_ind_max) +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = ind_xlim,
    ylim = ind_ylim,
    clip = "on"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Individual-wise PPC",
    # subtitle = "Participant-level means",
    x = "Observed mean",
    y = "Predicted mean"
  ) +
  panel_note(label_ind, x = -15, y = 22) +
  theme_ppc()


# ============================================================
# 7. Trial-wise PPC
# ============================================================

label_trial <- spearman_label(
  dat_ppc$y_true,
  dat_ppc$y_pred
)

p_trial <- ggplot(
  dat_ppc,
  aes(x = y_true, y = y_pred)
) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = "22",
    linewidth = abline_linewidth,
    colour = pal$accent
  ) +
  geom_point(
    colour = pal$point,
    alpha = point_alpha_trial,
    size = point_size_trial,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = trial_xlim,
    ylim = trial_ylim,
    clip = "on"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Trial-wise PPC",
    # subtitle = "Trial-level predictions",
    x = "Observed Allocation",
    y = "Predicted Allocation"
  ) +
  panel_note(label_trial, x = trial_xlim[1], y = trial_ylim[2]) +
  theme_ppc()


# ============================================================
# 8. Combine
# ============================================================

ppc_figure <- p_grand + p_ind + p_trial +
  plot_layout(
    ncol = 3,
    widths = c(1, 1, 1)
  ) +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "A",
    theme = theme(
      plot.tag = element_text(
        size = plot_tag_size,
        face = "bold",
        family = base_family
      )
    )
  )

print(p_grand)
print(p_ind)
print(p_trial)
print(ppc_figure)


# ============================================================
# 9. Save figures
# ============================================================

save_pub(
  p_grand,
  "ppc_grand_average",
  width = single_fig_width,
  height = single_fig_height
)

save_pub(
  p_ind,
  "ppc_individual_wise",
  width = single_fig_width,
  height = single_fig_height
)

save_pub(
  p_trial,
  "ppc_trial_wise",
  width = single_fig_width,
  height = single_fig_height
)

save_pub(
  ppc_figure,
  "ppc_three_panel",
  width = three_panel_width,
  height = three_panel_height
)


# ============================================================
# 10. Save source data and print correlations
# ============================================================

write_csv(
  dat_ppc,
  file.path(fig_dir, "ppc_trial_level_source_data.csv")
)

write_csv(
  subject_ppc,
  file.path(fig_dir, "ppc_subject_level_source_data.csv")
)

cat("\n=== Individual-wise PPC ===\n")
print(
  suppressWarnings(
    cor.test(
      subject_ppc$mean_true,
      subject_ppc$mean_pred,
      method = "spearman",
      exact = FALSE
    )
  )
)

cat("\n=== Trial-wise PPC ===\n")
print(
  suppressWarnings(
    cor.test(
      dat_ppc$y_true,
      dat_ppc$y_pred,
      method = "spearman",
      exact = FALSE
    )
  )
)

cat(
  "\nSaved figures and source data to: ",
  normalizePath(fig_dir),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)


```
